name: OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex
prettyType: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset (Fin d → ℕ)

name: OAI.PiExponent.mem_natWeightedSimplex
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} {w : Fin d → ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) → ∀ {N : ℕ} {a : Fin d → ℕ}, a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex w N ↔ ∑ i, w i * a i ≤ N

name: OAI.PiExponent.residueRectangle
prettyType: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Finset (Fin d → ℕ)

name: OAI.PiExponent.mem_residueRectangle
prettyType: ∀ {d : ℕ} {w r : Fin d → ℕ}, r ∈ OAI.PiExponent.residueRectangle w ↔ ∀ (i : Fin d), r i < w i

name: OAI.PiExponent.card_residueRectangle
prettyType: ∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ), (OAI.PiExponent.residueRectangle w).card = ∏ i, w i

name: OAI.PiExponent.simplex_count_lower_sandwich
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ (N : ℕ),
      (OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex (fun x => 1) N).card ≤ (OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex w N).card * ∏ i, w i

name: OAI.PiExponent.simplex_count_upper_sandwich
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ (N : ℕ),
      (OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex w N).card * ∏ i, w i ≤
        (OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex (fun x => 1) (N + ∑ i, (w i - 1))).card

name: OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex_one
prettyType: ∀ (d N : ℕ), OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex (fun x => 1) N = OAI.PiExponent.unweightedSimplex d N

name: OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_card_natWeightedSimplex
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ↑(OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex w N).card / ↑N ^ d) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(w i))))

name: OAI.PiExponent.mem_realWeightedSimplex
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} {w : Fin d → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {H : ℝ} {a : Fin d → ℕ}, a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex w H ↔ ∑ i, w i * ↑(a i) ≤ H

name: OAI.PiExponent.mem_strictWeightedSimplex
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} {w : Fin d → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {H : ℝ} {a : Fin d → ℕ}, a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.strictWeightedSimplex w H ↔ ∑ i, w i * ↑(a i) < H

name: OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex_scaled
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {c H : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        0 ≤ H →
          OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex (fun i => ↑(w i) / c) H = OAI.PiExponent.natWeightedSimplex w ⌊c * H⌋₊

name: OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_card_realWeightedSimplex_scaled
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {c : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun H => ↑(OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex (fun i => ↑(w i) / c) H).card / H ^ d)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(w i)) * c ^ d))

name: OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_card_strictWeightedSimplex_scaled
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {c : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun H => ↑(OAI.PiExponent.strictWeightedSimplex (fun i => ↑(w i) / c) H).card / H ^ d)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(w i)) * c ^ d))

name: OAI.PiExponent.positive_rational_weights_common_denominator
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d → ℚ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < ρ i) → ∃ D, 0 < D ∧ ∃ w, (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin d), ↑(ρ i) = ↑(w i) / ↑D

name: OAI.PiExponent.common_denominator_simplex_constant
prettyType:
∀ {d D : ℕ} {ρ : Fin d → ℚ} {w : Fin d → ℕ},
  0 < D →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
      (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑(ρ i) = ↑(w i) / ↑D) →
        1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(w i)) * ↑D ^ d = 1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(ρ i))

name: OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_card_realWeightedSimplex_rational
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d → ℚ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < ρ i) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun H => ↑(OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex (fun i => ↑(ρ i)) H).card / H ^ d) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(ρ i))))

name: OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_card_strictWeightedSimplex_rational
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d → ℚ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < ρ i) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun H => ↑(OAI.PiExponent.strictWeightedSimplex (fun i => ↑(ρ i)) H).card / H ^ d) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (1 / (↑d.factorial * ∏ i, ↑(ρ i))))

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.row_card
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (v0 θ : ℝ) (w : Fin m → ℝ) (H : ℝ),
  Fintype.card (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ w H) =
    K * (OAI.PiExponent.strictWeightedSimplex (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.rowWeights v0 θ w) H).card

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.ceil_log_weight_pos
prettyType: ∀ {q : ℕ}, 2 ≤ q → 0 < ↑⌈Real.log ↑q⌉₊

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rowCount
prettyType: {m : ℕ} → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → (Fin m → ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.lowIndexCount
prettyType: {m : ℕ} → ℚ → (Fin m → ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rationalLogWeights
prettyType: {m : ℕ} → (Fin m → ℕ) → Fin m → ℚ

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rationalLogWeights_cast
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℕ) (i : Fin m),
  ↑(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rationalLogWeights q i) = OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rationalLogWeights_pos
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) → ∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rationalLogWeights q i

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.tendsto_rowCount_normalized
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (v0 θ : ℚ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  0 < v0 →
    0 < θ →
      (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun H => OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rowCount K v0 θ q H / H ^ (m + 1)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (↑K * ↑θ ^ m / (↑(m + 1).factorial * ↑v0 * ∏ i, OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i)))

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.tendsto_lowIndexCount_normalized
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : ℚ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  0 < A →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun H => OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.lowIndexCount A q H / H ^ m) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (↑A ^ m / (↑m.factorial * ∏ i, OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i)))

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.tendsto_row_lowIndex_ratio
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (v0 θ A : ℚ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  0 < v0 →
    0 < θ →
      0 < A →
        (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun H =>
              OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rowCount K v0 θ q H /
                (H * OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.lowIndexCount A q H))
            Filter.atTop (nhds (↑K * ↑θ ^ m / ((↑m + 1) * ↑v0 * ↑A ^ m)))

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.tendsto_collisionRatio
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (K : ℕ) (v0 θ A : ℚ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  0 < v0 →
    0 < θ →
      0 < A →
        (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
          ∀ (c η : ℝ),
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun H =>
                c * η ^ 2 * OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.rowCount K v0 θ q H /
                  (H * OAI.PiExponent.MatrixCounting.lowIndexCount A q H))
              Filter.atTop (nhds (c * η ^ 2 * ↑K * ↑θ ^ m / ((↑m + 1) * ↑v0 * ↑A ^ m)))

name: OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.finiteDenominators_two_le
prettyType:
∀ {nu : ℝ} (d : OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.FixedData nu) (i : Fin d.m),
  2 ≤ OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.finiteDenominators d i

name: OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.tendsto_collisionRate
prettyType:
∀ {nu : ℝ} (d : OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.FixedData nu),
  Filter.Tendsto (OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.collisionRate d) Filter.atTop
    (nhds (OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction.collisionLimit d))
